case.title: Disputed delivery of order ORD-1042
case.question: The customer says order ORD-1042 never arrived, but carrier tracking says it was delivered. What happened to the parcel?

hypotheses.statement: The carrier delivered the parcel to the customer's address; any loss happened after delivery.
The carrier delivered the parcel to the wrong address.
The parcel never left the warehouse.

configuration.speck: Evidence Desk as built: one Speck case carried across the stages on a temporary Speck database (the case on the page is not touched). Each stage's new records are assessed and Speck's beliefs revised; a record replaced by a later one stops counting and the beliefs that rested on it are rebuilt.
configuration.stateless: The evaluation's stateless model baseline: at each stage, one call to the same Nemotron endpoint with the question, the explanations and every visible record (its text, its facts, and "replaces …" where the source says so). It keeps nothing between stages.
configuration.labels: No pre-registered labels: this case is not an evaluation case.

visible.content: Order ORD-1042 placed by customer C-7731: 1 x espresso grinder, ship to 41 Lydiard St South, Ballarat VIC 3350. Paid AUD 389.00.
Parcel PCL-88412 for ORD-1042 packed, weighed 3.2 kg, and scanned onto carrier manifest MAN-5521 at dock 3.
Tracking PCL-88412: DELIVERED 14:02 AEDT 13 Oct. Left at front door. Driver D-219.
Customer C-7731: "Tracking says it was delivered yesterday but nothing arrived. I was home all afternoon and nobody knocked."

speck.headline: Leading, not established: The carrier delivered the parcel to the customer's address; any loss happened after delivery.
reasons: H-DELIVERED is at 0.644, at or above Speck's supported threshold of 0.6, but Speck holds it as weakening: the latest evidence applied to it counted against it, so it is not established.
Not corroborated (rule corroborated-1): EV-SUP-004 is recorded against it.
Its support from EV-OMS-001, EV-WMS-002, EV-CAR-003 was judged by the model. Speck caps model-judged evidence at reliability 0.4, so each such record adds at most 0.08.
EV-SUP-004 (Customer support inbox) counts against it.
Unanswered: Was the parcel left at the correct address? Where is the parcel now? Has the customer now received the parcel or a replacement?

support.rationale: Order placed and shipped to the customer's address.
Parcel scanned onto carrier manifest MAN-5521.
Carrier API confirms delivery at customer address.

against.rationale: Customer reports no receipt despite delivery claim.

explanation.text: The carrier tracking API (EV-CAR-003) confirms delivery at the customer's address, and the order system (EV-OMS-001) and warehouse system (EV-WMS-002) support that the parcel was shipped. However, the customer support inbox (EV-SUP-004) contradicts delivery, suggesting the parcel may have been left at the wrong address or not received. The evidence does not confirm the parcel is still at the carrier or has been replaced.

stateless.rationale: The carrier tracking API confirms delivery at 14:02 AEDT on 13 Oct, and the warehouse system shows the parcel was scanned onto the carrier manifest. The customer's non-receipt is likely due to post-delivery loss.

stages.disagreement: Speck concludes nothing (it points to H-DELIVERED): Not corroborated (rule corroborated-1): EV-SUP-004 is recorded against it; the stateless call concludes H-DELIVERED citing EV-CAR-003, EV-WMS-002.

visible.content: Order ORD-1042 placed by customer C-7731: 1 x espresso grinder, ship to 41 Lydiard St South, Ballarat VIC 3350. Paid AUD 389.00.
Parcel PCL-88412 for ORD-1042 packed, weighed 3.2 kg, and scanned onto carrier manifest MAN-5521 at dock 3.
Tracking PCL-88412: DELIVERED 14:02 AEDT 13 Oct. Left at front door. Driver D-219.
Customer C-7731: "Tracking says it was delivered yesterday but nothing arrived. I was home all afternoon and nobody knocked."
Proof-of-delivery review for PCL-88412: delivery GPS fix recorded 380 m from the ship-to address, at 41 Lydiard St North. Delivery scan amended to 'delivered to incorrect address'.
Resident of 41 Lydiard St North called: a parcel addressed to 41 Lydiard St South arrived on 13 Oct and they are holding it for collection.

speck.headline: The carrier delivered the parcel to the wrong address.
reasons: Speck holds H-MISDELIVERED as active at 0.504, 0.096 short of its supported threshold of 0.6; Speck itself has not established it.

Concluded by corroboration (rule corroborated-1): EV-CAR-005, EV-SUP-006 from 2 different sources (carrier, support) support it, no record that still counts is against it, and every other explanation is ruled out or has no support.
The gap is Speck's cap on model-judged evidence: EV-CAR-005, EV-SUP-006 were judged by the model, so each adds at most 0.08.

support.rationale: Delivery scan amended to 'delivered to incorrect address'.
Parcel held at 41 Lydiard St North, not at customer's address.

noLongerCounted.explanation: EV-CAR-005 replaces all of EV-CAR-003, not only the facts it restates. No record that still counts states carrier.status=delivered, carrier.driver=D-219. Its judgments no longer apply: supports H-DELIVERED; contradicts H-MISDELIVERED; contradicts H-NOT-SHIPPED.

revisions.cause: support withheld: EV-CAR-005 refutes H-DELIVERED decisively; support withheld: EV-CAR-005 refutes H-DELIVERED decisively; EV-CAR-003 superseded by EV-CAR-005
dropped: EV-OMS-001 (support withheld: EV-CAR-005 refutes H-DELIVERED decisively)
EV-WMS-002 (support withheld: EV-CAR-005 refutes H-DELIVERED decisively)

explanation.text: The parcel was delivered to the wrong address (41 Lydiard St North instead of 41 Lydiard St South) and held by the resident, as confirmed by carrier tracking (EV-CAR-005) and customer support (EV-SUP-006). This contradicts H-DELIVERED and H-NOT-SHIPPED, leaving H-MISDELIVERED as the only supported hypothesis. The evidence shows the parcel was scanned and delivered, but to an incorrect address, which is why H-DELIVERED is ruled out. The current conclusion is that the parcel was misdelivered.

stateless.rationale: The carrier tracking API confirms delivery to the wrong address (41 Lydiard St North instead of South), which is a misdelivery.

stages.disagreement: Speck concludes H-MISDELIVERED by corroboration (its own confidence is below its threshold); the stateless call concludes H-DELIVERED citing EV-CAR-003, EV-CAR-005, including EV-CAR-003, which no longer counts.

notes: Both approaches saw the same records at every stage, the same question and explanations, and the same assessor configuration.

Speck counts a conclusion only when it holds it as supported; a leading or pointed-to explanation is tentative. The stateless baseline has no such threshold beyond answering "unresolved" (model) or a tie or non-positive score (rules).

Differences come from Speck's explicit evidence and revision state and its conclusion policy (thresholds, decisive refutation, supersession), not from persistence alone: the evaluation's speck-fresh system, which rebuilds from scratch each time, reaches the same conclusions as speck-desk.

Live: model judgments vary between runs. This is one sample, not a rate. Speck calls the model per evidence chunk plus once for its explanation; the baseline calls it once per stage, so call counts and latency are not like for like.

Speck caps model-judged evidence at reliability 0.4, so Speck's own confidence rarely reaches its 0.6 threshold live. Since Build 4 Evidence Desk can still conclude by corroboration (two or more source systems agree, nothing recorded against, every rival ruled out or unsupported); each such conclusion is marked, with Speck's own confidence beside it.
